raw_segments.text: "'I thank you, honored, sir,' she began loftily.
"'The causes that have induced us—take the money, Polenka.
You see there are generous and honorable people who are ready to help a poor, gentle woman
You see, honored, sir, these orphans of good family I might even say of aristocratic connections
and that wretch of a general sat eating grouse, and stamped at my disturbing him.
"'Your excellency,' I said, "'protect the orphans, for you knew my late husband,
Semyon Zaharovich, and on the very day of his death the basest of scoundrels slandered
"'That policeman again—protect me,' she cried to the official.
"'Why is that policeman edging up to me?
We have only just run away from one of them.
